reviewer.name: Hypatia
reviewer.method: Same retained independent code-blind visual judge; pixels only.

scope: Frozen current High DAY scenery quarter: twelve destinations, four views and clear/rain. This is an independent appearance judgment of supplied stills, with five explicitly matched original-before/current Three Bells Bridge comparisons.
reason: Landmarks, route markers and high drops generally remain legible, but the full appearance bar fails on recurring uniform ground and abrupt dirt patches, coarse/inconsistent stone finish, visible contact/seam defects and heavy HUD coverage. Capture coverage is not acceptance.

inspection.remaining_current_originals: 69 current originals inspected as complete-frame contact cells only. No claim that all 96 originals were opened full-size.

reference_basis: docs/design/ART_DIRECTION.md: previously inspected approved appearance/material/shape/readability and Cloudreach sky/stone requirements.
docs/ACCEPTANCE.md: previously inspected F40#3 full visual matrix/fight requirements, F40#5 visible placeholder/floating/clipping prohibition and F08 visual camera/settlement scope.

day_full_bar_appearance.reason: Visible terrain, material and contact problems block the full pictured appearance bar.

day_landmark_and_route_identity.scope: Bounded supplied headings where the subject is visible.
day_landmark_and_route_identity.reason: Gold bells/bridge, Aviary dome/towers, gate/arch landmarks and settlement exteriors remain recognizable. Explicit heading omissions are recorded per context.

day_clear_rain_static_distinction.reason: Rain streaks, darker foregrounds and reduced distant visibility distinguish rain from clear; layered cliffs/cloud deck remain readable in clear views.

complete_atmosphere_motion_time_matrix.reason: This Day quarter cannot establish dawn, golden, night, transitions, moving clouds, god-ray motion or weather evolution. No other clock is rejudged here.

literal_day_contact_subset.reason: Broken Skyroad foreground turf/cliff seam, unsupported-looking gate threshold and isolated pole-like geometry are visible. This is not whole F40#5 closure or a source/cause diagnosis.

settlements_and_cliff_identity.reason: Galefoot camp props/houses and Cliffhold commons/houses read as distinct inhabited settlements on high land. Cliffhold approach is interior and does not establish exterior arrival framing.

high_perch_camera.reason: Supplied roost court/edge views remain readable, but no earned arrival/departure, landing transition or full C2 context is shown.

largest_three.requirement: Reference-backed layered landforms and coherent materials, without bare tiled planes or seams.
largest_three.finding: Broad green turf and repeated dirt strips dominate; camp/commons dirt patches have straight and angular edges. Large brown/green stone surfaces are coarse and generic beside the reference pale-stone/gold/glass language.

largest_three.requirement: No visible floating/clipping; ground and structure contact must read coherently.
largest_three.finding: The Broken Skyroad rain approach exposes a thin light open line between foreground turf and cliff. Realm Gate rain approach shows the lower gate/threshold separated above the grassy approach without visible continuous connection. Flight Aerie gameplay clear/detail rain contain an isolated pole-like piece against sky without visible support.
largest_three.limits: Static projected appearance only. No physics, hidden support, runtime cause or before/current regression attribution.

largest_three.requirement: Readable camera/UI without heavy visual obstruction; subjects retain clear designed finish.
largest_three.finding: Large fixed objective/minimap panels cover a substantial right-side world region, including bridge rails. Perch columns and nearby horned creature show coarse material patches rather than clear reference finish. Interior Cliffhold approach pictures a closed room rather than cliff arrival.
largest_three.limits: No device/controller usability, creature pose-suite or implementation-camera-cause claim.
